author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Ok two things that can be cool on the website


1. You are scrolling through a forum post and there is a green dot to a name you see. This indicates the player is online on Avicus

2. Badges appear on the forums next to your username if you post something. Say you get the omega badge in red. the omega badge appears next to what you post and it is red (like the shield icon mods have on the forums)

^ and if you go to profile you should be able to go to "settings" which let's you toggle these accessories 

Opinions?
